title: Overwhelming Presence Guide — Ailment Threshold, Stun Threshold and Aura Value
summary: Overwhelming Presence is a Spirit gem that radiates an aura reducing enemies' Elemental Ailment Threshold and Stun Threshold inside its radius. It does not directly add damage; it makes your existing ailments and stuns easier to apply. This guide covers the aura radius, what the threshold reductions affect, Aura Magnitude scaling, the current cap, and synergy with Combat Frenzy, Freezing Mark and Herald of Thunder.
description: Overwhelming Presence deep guide: Spirit cost, aura radius, Reduced Elemental Ailment Threshold, Freeze/Shock/Ignite/Electrocute coverage, Reduced Stun Threshold vs More Stun Buildup, boss special thresholds, Aura Magnitude scaling, current cap, no debuff icon, skill interactions, mapping vs boss value, troubleshooting and community questions.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial
imageAlt: Overwhelming Presence spirit aura skill icon

sections.title: Quick Answer
paragraphs: Overwhelming Presence is an aura that lowers the Elemental Ailment Threshold and Stun Threshold of enemies inside its radius, making your Freeze, Shock, Ignite and Stun easier to apply.
It does not directly increase your damage; it lowers the threshold enemies need to cross, so your existing hits land ailments and stuns more often.
Enemies do not show a visible debuff icon for the threshold reduction — the effect is passive while they are in range.

properties.label: Category
notes: Tagged spirit, aura, ailment, stun, debuff.

sections.title: Requirements
paragraphs: Overwhelming Presence reserves 60 Spirit, so it competes with other auras and Herald effects. You need a way to apply ailments or stuns for it to do anything.

sections.title: Persistent Buff
paragraphs: While reserved, the aura is always on around you. Enemies entering the radius immediately take the reduced thresholds; leaving the radius removes the effect.
bullets: Always-on aura while Spirit reserved.
Effect applies inside the radius only.
Leaving the radius drops the debuff.

sections.title: Threshold Aura
paragraphs: The aura reduces the Elemental Ailment Threshold and Stun Threshold of enemies inside it. Lower thresholds mean less buildup is needed to Freeze, Shock, Ignite or Stun.
Bosses may have special thresholds or immunities; the aura helps with normal enemies and many bosses but does not remove hard stun immunity.
bullets: Reduces ailment and stun thresholds.
Helps normal enemies and many bosses.
Boss immunities still apply.

sections.title: Ailment Analysis
paragraphs: Freeze benefits because the threshold to complete a Freeze is lower. Shock benefits because reaching the Shock threshold is easier, though the aura does not guarantee a high Shock magnitude.
Ignite benefits if the ignite threshold is lowered per current rules, but the aura does not directly raise Ignite DPS. Electrocute shares the stun/ailment family and is easier to apply.
The aura affects the threshold, not your hit damage — you still need to actually deal the ailment.
bullets: Freeze: lower completion threshold.
Shock: easier to reach, magnitude not boosted.
Ignite / Electrocute: easier to apply.

sections.title: Stun Analysis
paragraphs: Reduced Stun Threshold makes enemies Stunnable with less buildup. This is different from More Stun Buildup, which adds to your own stun contribution.
Use the aura when you want enemies stunned more reliably; pair it with stun-building hits for the best result.
bullets: Lowers enemy stun threshold.
Distinct from More Stun Buildup.
Pairs with stun-building hits.

sections.title: Aura Magnitude
paragraphs: Aura Magnitude scales the reduction values. The current client enforces a maximum reduction cap, so past a point more Magnitude does not help.
Quality may add to the reduction or magnitude; check the live tooltip for the exact current numbers.
bullets: Magnitude scales the reductions.
A current cap limits maximum reduction.
Quality may add reduction or magnitude.

sections.title: Spirit Budget
paragraphs: At 60 Spirit, Overwhelming Presence is a major reservation. You must decide between it and other auras or Herald effects that also want Spirit.
It is worth it when your build already applies lots of ailments or stuns and wants them to land more consistently.
bullets: 60 Spirit reservation.
Competes with other auras and Herald.
Worth it for ailment/stun-heavy builds.

sections.title: Skill Interactions
paragraphs: Combat Frenzy and Freezing Mark trigger or activate more easily when enemies are already afflicted, and the lowered thresholds help land the initial ailment.
Herald of Thunder gains Shock more easily from your lightning hits, though you still need kills for its effect. Tempest Flurry's Shock and Stun usage benefits from the lowered thresholds.
It differs from Withering Presence, which applies a different debuff family.
bullets: Combat Frenzy / Freezing Mark: easier to trigger.
Herald of Thunder: easier Shock, still needs kills.
Tempest Flurry: better Shock and Stun.

sections.title: Mapping Value
paragraphs: In maps, the aura keeps packs Frozen, Shocked and Stunned as you move through them, which is strong crowd control for clear speed and safety.
Because it is an aura, melee and close-range builds stay inside it; ranged builds may out-range their own aura and lose the benefit.
bullets: Strong pack crowd control in maps.
Best for melee and close-range.
Ranged may leave the aura radius.

sections.title: Bossing Value
paragraphs: Against bosses, the lowered Stun Threshold helps lock down stunnable bosses, and easier Shock supports Herald of Thunder procs.
Bosses with stun immunity get less value, so weigh the 60 Spirit against your other options per fight.
bullets: Helps stun-lock stunnable bosses.
Easier Shock for Herald procs.
Less value vs stun-immune bosses.

sections.title: Build Usage
paragraphs: Overwhelming Presence fits ailment and stun-heavy caster builds such as Cold Caster Chronomancer, where Freeze and Shock uptime matter.
It is a high-Spirit commitment, so it suits builds with spare Spirit after their core auras.
bullets: Cold Caster Chronomancer: freeze/shock uptime.
Stun-focused melee: lockdown.
Needs spare Spirit.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: If enemies show no debuff icon, that is expected — the threshold reduction is passive and has no icon. If ailments still will not land, your hits are too weak or the enemy is immune.
If the aura feels useless at range, you are out-ranging it; move closer or skip it on a ranged build.
bullets: No icon: expected, effect is passive.
Ailments still fail: weak hits or immunity.
Useless at range: you left the radius.
No damage boost: it lowers thresholds, not damage.
Spirit conflict: balance with other auras.

sections.title: Known Issues
paragraphs: A common mistake is expecting direct damage from the aura; it only lowers thresholds. Another is assuming the reduction has no cap — the current client caps it.
bullets: Aura does not add direct damage.
Reduction is capped at the current maximum.

sections.title: Community Evidence
paragraphs: Overwhelming Presence is discussed as a strong aura for ailment and stun builds in 0.5 threads, with the main caveat being the 60 Spirit cost.
Players note the lack of a visible debuff icon confuses newcomers.
bullets: Strong for ailment/stun builds, costs 60 Spirit.
No icon causes confusion.
